title: X-34 Landspeeder
description: Luke Skywalker's X-34 landspeeder was a zippy repulsor craft, augmented by a trio of air-cooled thrust turbines. It zoomed between Anchorhead and Tosche Station in a blink and was kept in prime condition, Skywalker carefully maintaining it to keep it running in the harsh Tatooine climate. He used the landspeeder to chase down R2-D2 and get to Mos Eisley, but that's when he had to sell it. Forced to sell the speeder for cheaper than he wanted due to the availability of the XP-38, Luke used the proceeds to help pay for passage to Alderaan.
